title: Mailing questions back, as with Driggs
summary: Albert offers to answer leftover questions in writing.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: I got a million questions here.

Well I tell you what, if you don't finish those questions, you mail them in to me and I'll do just like I do with Dick Allen. I'll answer them against the question. Leave a space there. Yeah. So I can just write it in there. Yeah.
You mean like you do with Driggs? With Driggs?
Dick Allen. What the hell am I?
Well you see, Driggs will ask a question. Yeah. And that leaves a space and I'll just answer them there.
